blocks.title: -ed of -ing?
blocks.text: -ed beschrijft hoe iemand zich voelt, -ing wat het gevoel veroorzaakt: I'm bored because the film is boring. Zo ook interested / interesting, tired / tiring, surprised / surprising.

blocks.title: Ik verveel me = I'm bored
blocks.text: Ik ben saai is I'm boring; dat bedoel je meestal niet. Ik verveel me is I'm bored. Zo ook: ik ben geïnteresseerd = I'm interested, niet I'm interesting.

rows: It was a very interested book.
It was a very interesting book.

blocks.text: Vorm het juiste woord uit het woord tussen haakjes. De antwoorden staan op de laatste pagina.

items.q: We need to make a ______ today.
items.full: We need to make a decision today.

items.q: There has been a big ______ in his work.
items.full: There has been a big improvement in his work.

items.q: Don't be so ______! Wait your turn.
items.full: Don't be so impatient! Wait your turn.
I think you misunderstood the question.

items.q: Climbing without a rope is very ______.
items.full: Climbing without a rope is very dangerous.

items.q: I spent my ______ in a small village.
items.full: I spent my childhood in a small village.

items.q: Het was een heel interessant boek.
items.a: It was a very interesting book.
